match.ring_count_basis.note: Native SSSR ring counts are kept; RDKit uses symmetrized rings.

smirks.colon_product_bond.note: Both flag the atoms aromatic; outside a ring RDKit keeps the raw product, which fails its sanitize, and chematic drops it.

smirks.fragmented_reactant.note: The RDKit adapter passes the molecule once per reactant template; chematic run_smirks with the same two reactants gives RDKit's COCO.

smirks.hcount_query_explicit_h.note: Explicit-H reactants give the implicit-H products (#734 item 5); every RDKit product here fails its own SanitizeMol.

smirks.product_h_atom_added.note: RDKit drops the added H atom and keeps CC[O-] raw; its sanitized product (CC[OH-]) is invalid, and chematic gives none.

smirks.product_h_pin.note: Explicit-H reactants give the implicit-H products (#734 item 5); RDKit C[CH5] fails its own SanitizeMol.

smirks.star_on_explicit_h.note: `*` edits heavy atoms of explicit-H reactants as in the implicit form (#734 item 5); every RDKit product here fails its own SanitizeMol.

smirks.valence_invalid_raw.note: RDKit returns an unsanitized product that fails its own SanitizeMol; chematic returns only sanitizable products.
